summary: Audit of Phase S4: oxfmt at d6b60a19, over the 25-commit range 85208f3a..d6b60a19. Verdict: PASS. Seven S4 tasks hold their commits (2cda0dec, 1acf85c4 with 4c4bd10e and 97ef1021, d0d4ad71, e5f474b5, dec3be20, 2046b47f, e65553da, 39ce245f, 7019c7b5); only the deferred [b] user-manual task is open, as the brief says. The five Red cases pass at HEAD: -t 'S4 oxfmt' gives 5 passed and 90 skipped. npm run format:check exits 0 on 3717 files. The config holds $schema and the 17 ignorePatterns of plan.md:452; the root scripts are exactly oxfmt and oxfmt --check; oxfmt is pinned to the exact 0.78.0. The format commit dec3be20 holds 3499 files, zero ignore-pattern hits, and none of the six dirty generated paths. .git-blame-ignore-revs works: plain blame gives dec3be20 and the ignore file gives ccfe3571. Review A ran at d6b60a19, the same SHA as HEAD and as role_base_sha, so no implementation commit came after the review. The single commit after the Green head fc299733 is d6b60a19, a measure/runs log, so the Green result still applies. I re-derived the gate result with the gates.sh key(): every s4 test log and step log yields zero keys absent from baseline-m2. lint, test, and build exits are identical to baseline-m2 over 27 workspaces each; typecheck differs in 3 workspaces, and each difference is an improvement (n/a to 0, 2 to 1, 2 to 1). The fixture canonical JSON is equal at 85208f3a and at HEAD, with 49 entries. The S2 adversarial (13), S3 tsrs (8), and S3 adversarial (14) filters still pass. Two record-only evidence errors go to the S5 list. No blocker.

The fixture is in it: `git show --name-only dec3be20` lists scripts/__tests__/fixtures/lint-disable-allowlist.json at name-list line 3423, and the raw text changed while the canonical JSON stayed equal. Rationale: this is the same item as Review A F2 and it hides no failure, because the plan box's own check (canonical JSON equal, 49 entries) passes and test-strategy 17.1 lists the fixture in the pre-format change set. Record-only for the S5 list: correct the sentence.

PA2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan.md:479 and oxc-evidence.md (S4 oxfmt timing, 'The 18 ignore patterns are') state 18 ignorePatterns. The config file and the plan.md:452 list hold 17. Rationale: this is Review A F3. The file matches the target list entry for entry, so no gate reads a wrong list; a wrong count invites a false mismatch check later. Record-only for the S5 list.

ratings.evidence: Every S4 deliverable is in place and proven: format:check exits 0 on 3717 files, dec3be20 holds 3499 files with 0 ignore-pattern hits, the blame ignore file changes package.json:47 from dec3be20 to ccfe3571, and the five Red cases pass; the one edge is that oxfmt 0.78.0 needs a second pass on 4 files, which no guard covers (Review A F4).

Each S4 claim has a failing-first case (red-s4-8a3a7aca.log and red-s4-r2-524a1c7a.log give the five named AssertionErrors, and -t 'S4 oxfmt' now gives 5 passed), case 5 parses /on (\d+) files/ and requires 1 so a zero-file check fails, and the 26-case guard file passes; the falsification text for the anchor refutation case does not discriminate (Review A F5).

The phase diff is the planned change only: the config, the format commit, the blame file, the 12-file regression fix that the format commit required, the key() refinement, and Measure records; no production source changed after dec3be20 and the six dirty generated files stayed unstaged.

Every gate-critical number reproduces (3499 files, 3717 scanned, 94 passed and 1 failed of 95, 26 guard cases, 5 S4 cases, 49 fixture entries, 0 new keys, exits equal to baseline-m2), but two evidence sentences are wrong (plan.md:518 fixture claim, the 18-pattern count) and one before-sweep artifact was overwritten (Review A F7).
